			ap.name as name, ap.exempted_role as exempted_role
		FROM
			`tabAccounting Period` ap, `tabClosed Document` cd
		WHERE
			ap.name = cd.parent
			AND ap.company = %(company)s
			AND ap.disabled = 0
			AND cd.closed = 1
			AND cd.document_type = %(voucher_type)s
